reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 CHAR's argument-1 must be an integer per §1989:A.2.2 AR4 (no numeric function, §1989:A.2.3 GR2): the compiler must accept integer literals, unscaled items, integer functions and always-integral expressions, and refuse a non-integral literal, a scaled item, a numeric function, a non-numeric operand or a not-always-integral expression.

reader.notes: CHAR shares the Uniform 'i' screen with FACTORIAL and MOD. The NE item's VALUE drew COBOL0900 (a numeric literal VALUE on a numeric-edited item is not COBOL-85), a probe-writing artefact that did not stop the CHAR(NE) refusal from being reported.
